verdict.rationale: React itself is the official SDK/library (component model, JSX, hooks) that developers—including AI-native ones generating code—build against, documented extensively across react.dev, and it exposes an llms.txt for AI-native consumption (react-probe-1). However, there's no machine-readable API spec (openapi probes all 404, react-probe-2) or AI-agent-specific SDK tooling beyond standard docs. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent SDK/API schema, independent evidence of AI tools building successfully against it, richer AI-native integration docs beyond the single llms.txt file.
